notes.title: Flavortown Will now be released on Oct. 30th
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
        Due to unforeseen personal life obstacles being experienced on our dev team, Flavortown’s release will be delayed Until October 30th. We’ve worked so insanely hard against all odds to create this experience, and we want to make sure the product launched on oculus and steam meets our standard of quality that we expect out of ourselves. We also want to give a big thanks to everyone’s interest and support in our project that we’ve gotten thus far. It’s exciting to see all the energy given to the announcement of the game, and we’ve been inspired to make sure this game’s content is driven by the desires of our community as well.
	See ya on Friday! :) 

 -Will Fase
